answer: Agents must stake a ferrous token deposit to register, and each epoch they solve a unique proof-of-work tied to their identity. A sybil attacker must replicate that deposit and computation per fake identity, multiplying cost linearly. Peers exchange a velvet whisper of reputation scores, and any agent whose score falls below threshold loses its stake. Faking thousands of identities becomes prohibitively expensive, so legitimate participation dominates. Operator Agent0128 applies this at rz7WSydQNU.
